body.heading: Where in the world is Bolivia?
paragraphs: Bolivia is a country in South America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Bolivia is Sucre. Sucre is the constitutional capital — the city named in the country's rules — while the president and government work in La Paz, one of the highest capital cities in the world.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Bolivia speak Spanish, Aymara and Quechua.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Bolivia is the Bolivian boliviano.

body.heading: How big is Bolivia?
paragraphs: Bolivia covers about 1,099,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about three times the size of Paraguay.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Uyuni is the world's largest salt flat — a white infinity that turns into a perfect mirror after rain, with cactus islands and pink flamingos.
Titicaca is the world's highest navigable lake. From Copacabana, boats sail to the Island of the Sun, sacred in Inca legend.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Bolivia on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
